fixed_paragraph: When someone asks for my help, I often decline if it doesn't benefit me. When a friend shares their opinion, I challenge it if I disagree. When a group decision is being made, I push for my own ideas. When someone tries to persuade me, I resist unless they have strong evidence. When a conflict arises, I stand my ground and argue my point. When someone criticizes me, I defend myself fiercely. When a rule seems pointless, I question its validity. When someone expects me to agree, I often surprise them by not doing so. When I see a flaw in a plan, I point it out bluntly. When someone tries to take advantage of me, I make sure they regret it.
